info.title: Gapfy.Echo.Mock.Runner
info.description: Run isolated Echo HTTP mock snapshots and test commands without remote services.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Export, validate and run isolated Echo HTTP mock snapshots.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Acquire authorized rules before entering the offline test phase.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Exported Echo profile manifest with endpoint metadata.

options.name: --key-env
options.description: Environment variable containing the ServeMocks application key. [default: ECHO_API_KEY]

options.name: --seed
options.description: Fixed seed used by the offline runtime. [default: 1]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate snapshot integrity and complete rule coverage without opening a listener.

options.name: --report
options.description: JSON report without credentials or request bodies.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve a validated snapshot on an isolated loopback HTTP listener.

options.name: --report
options.description: JSON report without credentials or request bodies.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port; zero allocates a free port. [default: 0]

options.name: --ready-file
options.description: New file written only after readiness, removed when this runtime stops.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Serve a validated snapshot while running a child command. Place the command after --.

options.name: --report
options.description: JSON report without credentials or request bodies.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port; zero allocates a free port. [default: 0]

options.name: --ready-file
options.description: New file written only after readiness, removed when this runtime stops.
